claims.assertion: Swaruu says positive timelines and holographic society require unity; society emerges from members’ consciousness rather than imposed rules.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says co-present people may perceive different parallel worlds, densities and timelines despite seeing one another’s bodies.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: Swaruu says fear concentrates creative attention on feared outcomes, fostering nightmares, tulpas and regressive beings, while positive intentions remain scattered.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says holographic society requires treating collective needs as personal, overcoming separation and survival-focused thinking through cooperation.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
